description: Removed info.summary, an OpenAPI 3.1 field not allowed in this OpenAPI 3.0.2 document; its exact text was: "The Algolia A/B Testing API lets you manage your Algolia A/B tests to optimize your search experience". Represented 15 null-only oneOf alternatives ({type: null}, not valid in 3.0) as {type: string, nullable: true, enum: [null]}, which accepts only null, keeping every other alternative and oneOf exclusivity. No other content changed.
